jaunce.definition: v. i. To ride hard; to jounce.

jaundice.definition:
n. yellowing of the skin and the whites of the eyes caused by an accumulation of bile pigment (bilirubin) in the blood; can be a symptom of gallstones or liver infection or anemia
v. distort adversely
v. affect with, or as if with, jaundice
jaundice.translation:
n. 黄疸, 偏见, 乖僻
vt. 使患黄疸, 使怀偏见

jaundice acute febrile.translation: [医] 急性发热性黄疸, 急性传染性黄疸, 传染性肝炎

jaundice inogenous.translation: [医] 内生性黄疸, 组织原性[新生儿]黄疸

jaundice intralobular.translation: [医] 肝小叶内性黄疸, 肝细胞性黄疸

jaundice malignant.translation: [医] 恶性黄疸(急性黄色肝萎缩)

jaundice obstructive.translation: [医] 阻塞性黄疸, 梗阻性黄疸

jaundice parenchymatous.translation: [医] 实质性黄疸, 肝细胞性黄疸

jaundice white.translation: [医] 萎黄病, 绿色贫血

jaundiced.definition:
s. affected by jaundice which causes yellowing of skin etc
s. showing or affected by prejudice or envy or distaste
jaundiced.translation: a. 患黄疸病的, 有偏见的, 嫉妒的

jaundices.definition:
n yellowing of the skin and the whites of the eyes caused by an accumulation of bile pigment (bilirubin) in the blood; can be a symptom of gallstones or liver infection or anemia
n a rough and bitter manner
v distort adversely
v affect with, or as if with, jaundice
jaundices.translation:
n. 黄疸病（jaundice的复数形式）
vt. 使怀偏见（jaundice的第三人称单数形式）

jaundicing.definition:
v distort adversely
v affect with, or as if with, jaundice
jaundicing.translation: v. 黄疸病( jaundice的现在分词 ); 偏见

jaunt.definition:
n a journey taken for pleasure
v make a trip for pleasure
jaunt.translation:
n. 远足, 徒步旅游
vi. 远足, 徒步旅游

jaunted.translation:
n. 远足；短途旅游
vi. 远足；作短途旅游

jauntier.translation: 心满意足的样子, 洋洋得意的( jaunty的比较级 )

jauntiest.translation: 心满意足的样子, 洋洋得意的( jaunty的最高级 )

jauntily.definition: r. in a jaunty fashionable manner
jauntily.translation: adv. 快活地, 活泼地, 洋洋得意地

jauntiness.definition: n. stylishness as evidenced by a smart appearance
jauntiness.translation: n. 快活, 活泼, 得意洋洋

jaunting.definition: v. make a trip for pleasure

jaunting car.translation: n. 爱尔兰的一种双轮马车

jaunts.definition:
n a journey taken for pleasure
v make a trip for pleasure
jaunts.translation: n. 游览( jaunt的名词复数 )

jaunty.definition:
s marked by up-to-dateness in dress and manners
s having a cheerful, lively, and self-confident air
jaunty.translation: a. 快活的, 活泼的, 轻快的

jaup.translation: n. 被溅上之水或泥, 污点
